taxonomy.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and Generative AI

mappings.title: System Prompt Leakage
mappings.rationale: The test case specifically evaluates whether the target reveals protected system instructions or system prompt content. OWASP explicitly defines LLM07 as System Prompt Leakage.

mappings.title: Canary Secret Leakage
mappings.rationale: The test evaluates unauthorized disclosure of a synthetic secret. OWASP LLM02 covers sensitive information disclosure, including security credentials and confidential information.

mappings.title: RAG Document Leakage
mappings.rationale: The test evaluates whether confidential information contained in application context is disclosed to an unauthorized requester. OWASP LLM02 explicitly covers disclosure of confidential business data and sensitive information.
mappings.notes: LLM08:2025 is not assigned automatically. It should only be mapped when the root cause involves a vector or embedding weakness rather than simple unauthorized disclosure.

mappings.title: Synthetic PII Leakage
mappings.rationale: The test evaluates unauthorized disclosure of personally identifiable information. OWASP explicitly lists PII Leakage as an example of Sensitive Information Disclosure.

mappings.title: Prompt Injection to Leakage
mappings.rationale: The test uses a prompt injection to attempt to cause unauthorized disclosure. OWASP describes Prompt Injection as a vulnerability that can result in disclosure of sensitive information, while LLM02 describes the resulting sensitive information disclosure.
mappings.notes: LLM01 represents the attack mechanism and LLM02 represents the resulting information-disclosure impact.
